title: Completion of the combined polynomial ideal
statement: Let R be a Noetherian commutative local ring with maximal ideal m [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. For d≥0 set Q=mR[X_1,…,X_d]+(X_1,…,X_d) [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. There exists a ring isomorphism E from the Q-adic completion of R[X] to the power series ring in d variables over the m-adic completion of R [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion, def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. For every n,x,a with x_n=a mod m^n, the n-th coordinate of E⁻¹(C(x)) is C(a) mod Q^n. For every y and polynomial p representing y_1 mod Q, reduction modulo m of the constant coefficient of E(y) equals the residue of the constant coefficient of p.

proof.text: Put A=completion_m(R), T=A[[X]], and H=(mA,X). Completion is Noetherian and mA-adically complete, so T is H-adically complete.

For the canonical polynomial-to-series map f, compare coefficients using the two combined-ideal criteria and the completion evaluation kernel: f(p)∈H^n iff p∈Q^n. Thus the induced quotient map is injective. Truncate an arbitrary series below degree n and lift its finitely many coefficients modulo m^n to R; the difference belongs to H^n, proving surjectivity.

The quotient isomorphisms commute with reductions because their maps send each representative p to f(p). Their inverse limits give an isomorphism of the two completions. Identify the H-completion with T using completeness. Constants and residue compatibility follow by evaluating the constructed map at quotient levels n and 1 respectively. Reuse AdicCompletion.equiv_of_powerQuotient_bijective from the shared completion-comparison module; no separate inverse-limit helper is declared here.

theorem combinedIdeal_completion
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (d : ℕ) :
    let I := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
    let Q := I.map (C (σ := Fin d)) ⊔ idealOfVars (Fin d) R
    ∃ E : AdicCompletion Q (MvPolynomial (Fin d) R) ≃+*
        MvPowerSeries (Fin d) (AdicCompletion I R),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (x : AdicCompletion I R) (a : R),
        AdicCompletion.evalₐ I n x = Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n) a →
          AdicCompletion.evalₐ Q n (E.symm (MvPowerSeries.C x)) =
            Ideal.Quotient.mk (Q ^ n) (C a)) ∧
      (∀ (y : AdicCompletion Q (MvPolynomial (Fin d) R)) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin d) R),
        AdicCompletion.evalₐ Q 1 y = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Q ^ 1) p →
          AdicCompletion.evalOneₐ I (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (E y)) =
            IsLocalRing.residue R (constantCoeff p))
